Method.evidence: Wave 344 replaced three names that the map already carried from behavioural evidence: EvaluateOrderNumberFormattingScript, FormatDeviceVersion and FormatCouplerServiceControl. The property table identifies which property an entry formats; it does not overrule an established behavioural name, and the resource abbreviation CouplServControl is worse than CouplerServiceControl. This wave restores all three; the resulting map is byte-identical to v343 (59EE8414...).
Method.themes: Process fix: the builders for waves 330-343 all skipped tokens the current map already names; build-wave344.py lacked that guard and therefore re-proposed already-named rows from a weaker source. The guard is now in the builder, and the general rule is recorded: never re-name an existing map row unless the new evidence is strictly better than what produced the current name.
